fact: METEO-BENIN's strategic plan of 2 June 2022 lists staff awareness and training for ISO 9001-2015 as done and obtaining ISO 9001-2015 certification as a 2022-2026 objective, so the agency was not yet certified.
title: Plan stratégique 2022-2026
publisher: Agence Nationale de la Météorologie du Bénin (METEO-BENIN)
